objective: Derive the finest pair-level deterministic common quotient of all four RS-077 Pareto carriers, testing whether owner-count realizability preserves information lost by a Cartesian alphabet treatment.
scalarAccess: NONE: this phase enumerates finite structural alphabets only; no board solver, scalar evidence file, or W/D/L input is read.
capacity: Retain the common C active-sign-support cardinality unchanged. Its independent direct product does not affect the D/A partition audit.

domains.definition: All ordered (D+,D-,A+,A-) over D={0,1,2,3+}, A={0,1,2+}: 144 states.

For each sign independently, require integers x,y>=0 with D=clip3(x+y), A=clip2(abs(x-y)). Exact unsaturated feasibility is D>=A and D=A mod 2. The saturated single-sign alphabet is (0,0),(1,1),(2,0),(2,2+),(3+,0),(3+,1),(3+,2+), giving 49 ordered two-sign states.

domainProof: Necessity follows from x=(D+A)/2 and y=(D-A)/2 up to owner swap. Sufficiency follows from the same formulas. Saturation yields exactly the seven listed pairs: for D<3 inspect D=0,1,2; for D>=3 the witnesses (D,A)=(4,0),(3,1),(3,3) cover A=0,1,2+. No discarded exact count is restored to the state.
procedure: Enumerate both domains in numeric lexicographic order, using category codes only as names.
Evaluate the four frozen interval-aware maps using the canonical RS-077 library.
For each map connect all source states with equal map output; take the transitive closure of the union of these four equality relations.

Canonicalize each connected component by its least source-state index. This is the finest common quotient: any function factoring every carrier is constant along every edge and therefore on every component.
Publish all states, map keys, equality-component labels and per-carrier factor maps.
Measure whether the quotient is invariant under simultaneous plus/minus reversal, and under independent D-only and A-only reversal wherever both states belong to the domain.
Independently verify closure by graph traversal, not the generator's union-find, and verify factorization and maximality.
falsifiers: Any carrier fiber split by a component label invalidates common factorization.
Any two equally labelled states disconnected in the union graph invalidate maximality.
Any feasible integer owner-count pair outside the seven-symbol alphabet invalidates the domain proof.
A quotient invariant under simultaneous reversal cannot itself encode a globally directed pair state; preserve this as negative structural evidence.
interpretationGuards: OWNER_COUNT_REALIZABLE describes integer bucket feasibility, not complete board or triangle realizability.
Common pair-level factorization does not imply common triangle-level or GF(2) dependency-image minimality.
No scalar exactness or failure is inferred merely from partition size or directional symmetry.
No outcome-driven domain restriction, component split, feature exception, or preferred Pareto carrier is allowed.
A scalar qualification phase requires a separate frozen warrant after this structural audit; all four original carriers remain controls.
